faqHowToOrder: How do I place an order?
faqHowToOrderAnswer: Browse products, add them to your cart, and proceed to checkout. Once you confirm your payment and delivery details, your order will be placed.
faqTrackOrderAnswer: Yes, once your order is placed, you can track its real-time status under the 'My Orders' section in the app.
faqDeliveryTimeAnswer: Delivery times vary by location. Typically, standard deliveries take 1–3 business days, while express deliveries may arrive within a few hours.
faqPaymentMethodsAnswer: We accept multiple payment options including Cash on Delivery (COD), Debit/Credit Cards, and digital wallets (where supported).
faqCancelOrder: Can I cancel my order after placing it?
faqCancelOrderAnswer: Yes, you can cancel your order within 30 minutes of placing it. After that, cancellations may not be possible if the order has already been processed.
faqWrongOrDamaged: What if I receive the wrong or damaged item?
faqWrongOrDamagedAnswer: If your order is wrong or damaged, you can request a return or replacement within 7 days through the 'Help & Support' section.
faqDeliveryChargesAnswer: Delivery charges depend on your location and order size. You can view delivery fees before confirming your order at checkout.
faqUpdateAddress: How can I update my delivery address?
faqUpdateAddressAnswer: You can add, remove, or edit your delivery addresses from the 'My Account > Addresses' section of the app.
faqSecurePaymentsAnswer: Yes, we use encrypted and secure payment gateways to ensure your data remains safe.
faqDeliverToMyArea: Do you deliver to my area?
faqDeliverToMyAreaAnswer: We deliver to most areas. Enter your address during checkout to check availability in your location.
faqCustomerSupport: How do I contact customer support?
faqCustomerSupportAnswer: You can reach our support team through the 'Help & Support' section in the app or via the live chat option.
